items.headline: High Surf Warning issued November 12 at 10:22AM PST until November 14 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Large waves and dangerous surf conditions. Breakers up to
30 to 35 feet.

* WHERE...Clatsop County Coast and Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...From noon Friday to noon PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Destructive waves may wash over beaches, jetties,
and other structures unexpectedly. People can be swept off
rocks and jetties and drown while observing high surf. Severe
beach erosion may destroy coastal properties and buildings.
Higher than normal water run-up is expected on beaches and low-
lying shoreline.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The threat of sneaker waves is extreme
during these scenarios. Sneaker waves can suddenly knock
people off of their feet and quickly pull them into the frigid
ocean which may lead to serious injury or drowning. The
sneaker wave threat will peak Friday evening into Friday night.
items.instruction:
A High Surf Warning means that high surf will affect beaches,
producing rip currents, sneaker waves and beach erosion. Stay
well back from the water's edge and be alert for exceptionally
high waves.

Keep away from large logs on the beach. Water running up on the
beach can lift or roll logs which can injure or kill someone
caught in their path.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 12 at 8:09AM PST until November 13 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, seas 11 to 14 ft at 15
seconds and south winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt. For
the Gale Warning, seas 18 to 23 ft at 19 seconds and south
winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 45 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM, Waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
from 10 to 60 NM and Waters from Cape Foulweather to Florence
OR from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...Small Craft Advisory, until 7 PM PST this evening. Gale
Warning, from 7 PM this evening to 4 PM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Gale Warning means winds of 34 to 47 knots are imminent or
occurring. Operating a vessel in gale conditions requires
experience and properly equipped vessels. It is highly
recommended that mariners without the proper experience seek safe
harbor prior to the onset of gale conditions.
